name: Mosin-Nagant

skills.name: Patrol Time
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 9 tiles and deals Physical damage equal to 80% of attack to them.

skills.name: Target Victory
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 9 tiles, dealing Physical damage equal to 130% of attack to them. After the attack, applies Conductivity for 1 turn.

skills.name: Positive Mindset
skills.description: Gain 1 stack of Active Engagement, and Extra Command once. Every 3 times this skill is used, gain Shock. Cannot be used more than once per turn.

skills.name: Declaration of Victory
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 9 tiles, dealing Physical damage equal to 180% of attack to them. If a phase weakness is exploited, applies Paralysis to the target after the attack for 1 turn.

skills.name: Helping Others
skills.description:
When an allied unit attacks an enemy unit outside of turn but within range, if that enemy unit is in Stability Break, Mosin-Nagant performs 1 instance of Action Support, Physical damage equal to 80% of her attack and 2 points of Stability Damage. This effect can be triggered up to 2 times per turn.

After a Support Attack, Mosin-Nagant gains 2 points of Confectance Index, and also gains Insight for 2 turns.

fortification.effect: If a phase weakness is exploited, gains 1 point of Confectance Index.
Gains 1 stack of Unshakable Confidence after each Support Action.
Gains 1 point of Confectance Index for each stack of Unshakable Confidence after using an Ultimate skill.
Before performing a Support Attack, gains 1 stack of Active Engagement.
Increase damage dealt in Active Engagement by an additional 10%. Every 2 times this skill is used, gain Shock.
When an Electric debuff is applied to an enemy target outside of turn, gains Wise Support. The maximum number of Support Attack increases by 1.

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Security Patrol Squad
keys.effect: If the target has Paralysis, increases Stability Damage they take by 2 points.

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Preprepared Defenses
keys.effect: When Target Victory deals Electric damage, applies Paralysis for 1 turn instead of Conductivity.

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Orderly Movement
keys.effect: If the target has Paralysis, applies 2 debuffs to them before launching an attack.

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Positive Mindset
keys.effect: When using the active skill Positive Mindset, if the user has Shock, their attacks ignore 15% of Cover damage reduction.

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Hard at Work
keys.effect: When possessing Insight, reduce Stability Damage taken by 1 point.

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Mobile Patrol
keys.effect: If an active attack applies Paralysis to the target, this unit gains 3 tiles of Additional Movement.

keys.name: Common Key - All Seeing Eye
keys.effect: ATK +5.0% / When this unit is under the effects of Insight, increases damage dealt by 7%.

keys.name: Expansion Key - White Reaper
keys.effect: When allies attempt to apply Paralysis on the target, Mosin applies Electric Sparks on the target for 1 turn. This effect can only activate once per round
